messages:
jana: publishbot attempted to promote to staging but deploy-bot held it due to a provenance timestamp outside our acceptable TTL :alarm_clock:
deploy-bot: block reason: provenance.attest_kms_ts=2024-10-29T21:05:00Z for digest sha256:bf12a...c9e2 (allowed-grace=30h)
tess: ack. is this the mirrored-region key rotation causing older attestations again?
omar: looks like it. EU mirror rotated last night; attestations stamped with older time. options: force-republish with new attestation, or pin the deployment to the last-known-good digest while we fix it
henry: prefer pin + short change window rather than rolling back a bunch of canaries
jana: proposed plan:
- lock staging lane for a short change window (10m)
- pin affected services to previous digest sha256:6f3d...112a
- ops republish a corrected image to staging-temp and generate fresh cosign attestation using mirror KMS
- promote and run quick smoke; unpin after 2m observation
- update release-note snippet and add RB ticket link
oman: I can do the republish, assigning to myself. will push to staging-temp:resync and cosign with the EU mirror key
ops-bot: created ticket RB-4124 (label: provenance-resync) and attached this thread
tess: remember to add labels `provenance.mirror=eu-west-1` and `provenance.resynced_by=omar` so we can filter these later
omar: will do. locking lane now with deployctl:
```
deployctl lock --lane=staging --reason="provenance resync; pin during republish" --duration=10m
```
henry: pin command example:
```
redwoodctl service pin --service=web-staging --digest=sha256:6f3d...112a --note="pin during RB-4124 resync"
```
deploy-bot: automated promote 1785006789-1 blocked; hold created and RB-4124 attached
omar: starting republish push to staging-temp...
(120s)
omar: push finished. new digest sha256:e4d2...77fb. cosign attestation created with kms_ts=2024-11-05T09:18:00Z. uploading provenance metadata now
ops-bot: audit log: user=omar action=republish target=staging-temp digest=sha256:e4d2...77fb ticket=RB-4124
deploy-bot: attempting promote from staging-temp to staging
deploy-bot: promote succeeded, smoke tests: auth/login, checkout, background-worker - all OK :white_check_mark:
jana: after a 2m observation we unpin and release the lock
henry: updating release notes: "hotfix: pinned staging to sha256:6f3d...112a during provenance resync (RB-4124). new image sha256:e4d2...77fb promoted after resync." posting now to #release-notes
tess: add a short advisory for teams that rely on floating tags to validate cached manifests
omar: filed follow-up ORG-2299 to reduce grace window for mirrored attestations and add an alert when attestations post-rotation are older than 24h
jana: thanks all. closing once RB-4124 and release notes are updated. :thumbsup:
